scope-boundary: In scope: /chat engine resolution (persisted project/global agentic_engine + x-istara-agent-engine header), frontend per-request engine header on chat calls, a fail-closed guard that stops interactive chat from silently serving QA provider-stub contract models outside an explicit QA profile, AgenticCoreSection WCAG 2.2 AA contrast fixes in light+dark measured against root DESIGN.md tokens, and QA obligation registry entries so Pi and Istara cores are assessed (deterministic routing contracts; live smoke stays live_optional). Out of scope: replacing either engine, research-spine pipeline changes, VPS topology redesign beyond the stub-leak guard, OpenAI Codex OAuth configuration (deferred until the two-endpoint comparison stage), touching LLMs/ or Model_Finetuning/.
contract-compatibility: Chat SSE event shapes, route paths, request/response schemas, and dispatcher verb signatures stay unchanged. When no project setting is persisted and no header is present, engine resolution falls back to settings.agentic_engine_default exactly as today ('legacy'), so existing non-Pi behavior is byte-compatible. The model-catalog response keeps its current keys; only its 'engine' derivation gains the header-free persisted-source parity it already claims. Frontend adds a request header; no component APIs change.
verification-bar: CI-safe pytest must cover: (1) engine resolution precedence header > project > global > default for /chat; (2) interactive chat rejects/flags QA-contract models when the QA profile marker is absent; (3) frontend typecheck/lint/build pass with the new header wiring; (4) check_qa_capabilities.py and check_feature_obligations.py pass after registry extension; (5) a checked-in token-contrast measurement script proves every chooser color pair meets WCAG 2.2 AA in both modes. Evidence rows recorded in CF before any task finishes.
rollback: All changes land as small reversible commits on testing behind existing feature-flag idioms where risk exists. Per-phase revert via git revert of the phase's commit range; the stub guard ships with an explicit env override documented in TESTING.md so QA environments can re-enable their intended stub without code changes.
docs: docs/architecture/agentic_core.md (resolution order), docs/features/content/chat/model-controls/* (routing truth + regenerated site artifacts via scripts/feature_docs.py --seed-missing --generate-site --check), TESTING.md command matrix rows for the new contrast script and core-routing tests, docker-compose.vps.yml comments documenting why the stub cannot serve interactive chat.
